summary: I've written plan.md: a long, low single-storey house of white stucco and dark timber under a pale slab roof that rises only 1.5 blocks over a 10-cell half-span. Its eaves are 2 deep, beam ends stick out past them every 3 cells, and a flat carport roof sits one level lower beside it. The street side is blank apart from a tan ledgestone wall, a clerestory strip and an orange door; the back is floor-to-ceiling glass between dark posts, opening onto a kidney pool. Those layered horizontals, the central atrium and the teal-and-white car on the driveway are what make it read as an Eichler or Palm Springs house.
concept_subject: A 1950s California mid-century modern house on a flat suburban lot, seen from the street (north) at a three-quarter angle in hard desert sun. A long, low single-storey body, 22 blocks wide, of crisp white stucco sits on a thin concrete slab edge. Above it is a near-flat, very low gable roof of pale grey gravel slabs: the ridge runs along the street and rises only a block and a half. A thin dark-wood fascia rims the roof, and its deep 2-block eaves cast a band of shadow along the walls. Dark timber beam ends stick out past the eave every 3 blocks, front and back, above a continuous dark-oak header band. The street face is almost blank. On the left, a freestanding wall of tan stacked ledgestone stands one block proud. Beside it, a recessed entry holds a bold orange front door between orange panels. On the right, a slim strip of clerestory glass runs just under the eave, split by dark mullions. At the west end, a flat-roofed carport sits one level lower than the main eave on slender dark posts, closed at the back by a pierced white breeze-block screen. In front of it, on a pale concrete driveway with joint lines, is a long, sleek two-tone 1950s car: teal body, white roof, chrome bumpers, black tyres. The front yard is desert planting: tan sand, beds of grey gravel, a cluster of tall cacti, and two palms. Three concrete stepping pads lead from the sidewalk to the door, and a low mailbox stands at the head of the driveway. At the centre of the house is an open-air atrium courtyard, ringed by glass and crossed by an open beam. Thin glass clerestory bands show at both gable ends. The garden (south) side is a wall of floor-to-ceiling glass between thin dark posts, with sliding doors that open onto a concrete patio. Beyond it is a turquoise kidney-shaped pool with white coping, set in a concrete deck and lawn, with a third palm in the corner.
concept_size: 34 wide (x, along the street) by 34 deep (front yard, house and back pool), single storey, 8 tall (roof ridge at about 7 blocks; the chimney reaches 8)
